Both findings fixed on feat/recipe-tooling. make check passed before each commit; nothing pushed.

1. `cmd/beadle-daemon/verify_cmd.go:107` — resolveVerifySigner's not-exist wrap now uses `%w` so `errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist)` survives on the returned error. `cmd/beadle-daemon/sign_cmd.go`'s `checkSignerMatchesAuthorizer` now ignores only that case and returns every other resolution failure (unreadable/malformed daemon.json). Added `TestResolveVerifySigner_AbsentDaemonJSONIsErrNotExist` (verify_cmd_test.go) and `TestRunSign_MalformedDaemonJSONRefusesToSign` (sign_cmd_test.go, ambiguous owner_handle+owner_gpg_key_id case) — both branches now covered. Commit 610a98c.

2. `internal/daemon/templates.go:65` — reworded the `${CONTEXT7_API_KEY}` expansion claim as a stated assumption with its failure mode (unexpanded placeholder → literal string sent → auth fails, looks like a bad key not a config problem), and dropped the `.tmp/FIXBRIEF-recipe-tooling.md` reference. Commit 7fbe55d.

I grepped the branch's diff for other `if err != nil { return nil }` sites per your suggestion — the one you flagged was the only instance of that pattern.

Note: two other comments in this branch (`internal/daemon/templates.go:32`, plus refs in `runner_test.go`, `spawner_test.go`, `sign_cmd.go`, `sign_cmd_test.go`) also cite `.tmp/FIXBRIEF-recipe-tooling.md`. I left those alone since they weren't part of the two findings you named and I wanted to stay in scope for a "commit, don't push" fix round — flagging in case you want them swept in the same pass before merge.

tool_input.message:
Both fixes verified — `610a98c` and `7fbe55d`. The `%w` change at the `resolveVerifySigner` layer is the right place for it; fixing only the caller would have left it unable to distinguish the cases. And the two new tests cover both branches, which is what makes the fix real rather than plausible.

**Yes, sweep them.** Six references across five files, and you were right to flag rather than assume:

```
internal/daemon/runner_test.go
internal/daemon/spawner_test.go
internal/daemon/templates.go       (line 32, separate from the one you fixed)
cmd/beadle-daemon/sign_cmd.go      (two references)
cmd/beadle-daemon/sign_cmd_test.go
```

`.tmp/` is gitignored, so every one of these is a dangling citation the moment this merges — a reader who follows it finds nothing, and cannot tell whether the file was deleted or never existed.

**Replace the reference, keep the content.** Each of those comments is explaining something worth knowing — why a declared env var fails the stage, why a full struct re-marshal drops comments, what the round-trip proves. That reasoning should survive. Only the pointer is bad.

Rewrite each so it stands alone: state the reason inline rather than deferring to a document. Where a comment currently reads "as `.tmp/FIXBRIEF...` describes, X" it should just read "X, because Y." If a reference genuinely helps, point at something durable — the bead (`beadle-7gm`, `beadle-qtei`), the PR (#263), or `examples/recipes/README.md`. Nothing under `.tmp/`.

Staying in scope and flagging was the right call, and it caught something I would have merged. The two findings I named were the ones Copilot reported; this is a third that nobody reported, found because you looked at the neighbourhood rather than only the line.

Same discipline: `make check` before the commit, one commit, do not push.
